changes.clue_en: What English term names the technique used to preserve early live television by filming the image on a monitor onto film?
changes.clue_et: Millise ingliskeelse nimetusega võtet kasutati varajaste otsetelesaadete säilitamiseks, filmides monitoripildi filmilindile?
changes.explanation_en: Kinescope recording preserved a television image by photographing it from a monitor onto motion-picture film.
changes.explanation_et: Kinescope recording tähendab telepildi jäädvustamist monitorilt filmikaameraga filmilindile.

questions.reviewNotes: Asks explicitly for the English name in both languages because EKI kineskoop denotes a display tube; no verified standard Estonian recording-term equivalent was found. The English recording term is sourced directly to the Library of Congress, with newly authored explanation. Existing factual-source metadata remains in place.

sourceVerification.observation: Library of Congress describes filming a television monitor with a motion-picture camera and calls the result a kinescope recording.
EKI defines Estonian kineskoop as the older display component converting an electron-beam signal into a visible image.

changes.clue_en: Which annual three-week cycling stage race, held mainly in France, awards a yellow jersey to the overall leader?
changes.clue_et: Millises iga-aastases peamiselt Prantsusmaal peetavas kolmenädalases mitmepäevases jalgrattavõistluses kannab üldliider kollast särki?

questions.reviewNotes: Adds the French three-week race context to distinguish other races with yellow leader jerseys. Existing source metadata retained; organizer pages corroborate the yellow-jersey rule and three-week format.

sourceVerification.observation: Organizer identifies the yellow jersey as the individual general-classification leader’s jersey.
Organizer’s 2026 race guide describes three weeks and 21 stages.
